A '''Laser bone saw''' was a self-cauterizing [[Laser/Legends|laser]]-based surgical tool used by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn's]] [[Pawn]]s to remove the upper part of their subject's skulls.<ref name="som">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' </ref>
